CarFax No Accidents! CarFax One Owner! Popular Options and Features Include: Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
  • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. The refreshed 2025 Honda Odyssey Sport-L delivers an outstanding combination of family-friendly versatility, sophisticated technology, powerful V6 performance, and a surprisingly sporty personality. Finished in gorgeous Radiant Red Metallic II with a Black leather-trimmed interior featuring distinctive Red stitching, this attractive Odyssey has traveled just 27,614 miles since new. It boasts a ONE-OWNER CARFAX history, six documented service records, and an original suggested retail price of $45,320, making it an appealing opportunity to enjoy Honda's celebrated family vehicle with a wonderfully distinctive appearance. What makes this Odyssey especially appealing is the desirable Sport-L trim, which combines upscale amenities with exclusive styling details. Striking 19-inch Berlina Black alloy wheels, gloss-black exterior accents, leather-trimmed seating with Red stitching, heated front seats, a power moonroof, and dramatic Red ambient lighting give it a personality that sets it apart from the ordinary family minivan. Add Honda's powerful 280-horsepower V6, smooth 10-speed automatic transmission, dual power sliding doors, Magic Slide second-row seats, wireless smartphone connectivity, and comprehensive Honda Sensing technology, and this Odyssey offers an exceptional combination of practicality, comfort, and style. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL Few vehicles have earned the reputation for family-friendly practicality and thoughtful engineering that the Honda Odyssey has established over generations. Its combination of generous passenger space, powerful V6 performance, flexible seating, excellent visibility, and convenient everyday features makes it one of the most versatile vehicles on the road. One of the Odyssey's greatest strengths is that Honda designed it around the needs of actual families. Wide-opening power sliding doors make loading children and passengers easier in crowded parking lots, while the spacious three-row cabin provides comfortable accommodations for up to eight occupants. Its thoughtfully designed seats, useful storage compartments, and convenient controls make everyday transportation remarkably straightforward. Honda's exclusive Magic Slide second-row seating system is particularly ingenious. The individual seats can move laterally when the center seat is removed, allowing easier third-row access and greater flexibility for families with children, passengers, and car seats. The Odyssey also stands apart through its genuinely enjoyable driving character. Unlike some competitors that prioritize economy over performance, Honda equipped it with a strong naturally aspirated V6 and a sophisticated 10-speed automatic transmission. The result is confident acceleration, relaxed highway cruising, and a smooth driving experience that feels more like a refined sedan than a large family vehicle. Its impressive cargo capacity adds another major advantage. With a versatile third-row seat that folds into the floor and removable second-row seating, the Odyssey can accommodate everything from groceries and luggage to furniture, recreational equipment, and family vacation supplies. For shoppers comparing the Toyota Sienna, Kia Carnival, and Chrysler Pacifica, the Odyssey offers a particularly appealing combination of powerful V6 performance, versatile interior packaging, comfortable road manners, and Honda's thoughtful approach to everyday convenience. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION The Honda Odyssey has long received favorable attention from automotive journalists for its comfortable ride, impressive interior flexibility, powerful V6 engine, and family-oriented features. Car and Driver and Edmunds have consistently highlighted the Odyssey's enjoyable driving characteristics, generous cargo space, and exceptionally practical seating arrangements. The model's combination of refinement and versatility has helped it remain a benchmark in the minivan segment. The refreshed 2025 model brought meaningful improvements, including updated exterior styling, a larger nine-inch infotainment touchscreen, a revised seven-inch digital instrument display, and wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility. The Sport-L trim is especially noteworthy because it combines the Odyssey's traditional family-friendly advantages with a considerably more expressive appearance. Its exclusive gloss-black wheels, black exterior accents, leather seating with Red stitching, and ambient lighting create a sport-inspired presentation without sacrificing practicality. In independent safety testing, the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety awarded the 2025 Odyssey GOOD ratings in its small-overlap front and updated side-impact evaluations. The model also received an ACCEPTABLE headlight rating and an ACCEPTABLE pedestrian front crash-prevention rating. WARRANTY The odometer currently reads just 27,614 miles, with this Odyssey having entered personal service in approximately July 2025. This Odyssey is STILL COVERED by transferable Honda factory warranty protection, measured from an estimated in-service date of July 2025. - New Vehicle Limited Warranty Covers qualifying defects in materials or workmanship involving most original factory-installed vehicle components. Coverage continues through approximately July 2028 or 36,000 miles, whichever comes first. Approximately 8,386 miles remain under the mileage limitation. - Powertrain Limited Warranty Covers qualifying engine, transmission, and drivetrain components under Honda's applicable factory warranty terms. Coverage continues through approximately July 2030 or 60,000 miles, whichever comes first. Approximately 32,386 miles remain under the mileage limitation. - Corrosion Perforation Limited Warranty Provides protection against qualifying rust-through perforation of original body sheet metal. Coverage generally continues through approximately July 2030 with unlimited mileage. The available CARFAX history documents just ONE OWNER and six service records, including maintenance and inspections performed at authorized Honda dealerships. Particularly noteworthy maintenance includes: - July 2025 - 6 Miles Original pre-delivery inspection completed by Gary Yeomans Honda in Daytona Beach, Florida. - October 2025 - 4,974 Miles Maintenance inspection completed at Winter Haven Honda. Engine oil and filter changed. Tires rotated. - March 2026 - 17,140 Miles Maintenance inspection completed at Regal Honda in Lakeland, Florida. - October 2026 - 27,592 Miles Pre-delivery inspection completed at Honda of Ocala. Braking system checked. CARFAX also reports no open manufacturer recalls as of October 28, 2026. Extended service plans are available for owners who want protection beyond these factory terms. STANDARD FEATURES The Sport-L represents one of the most distinctive configurations in the 2025 Odyssey lineup, combining the upscale convenience equipment of the EX-L with an exclusive collection of sporty styling enhancements. Rather than merely changing the badges, Honda gave the Sport-L a unique visual personality with 19-inch Berlina Black wheels, gloss-black exterior trim, Red-accented leather seating, and matching ambient lighting. - 19-Inch Berlina Black Alloy Wheels Provide a bold, sophisticated appearance that beautifully complements the Sport-L's dark exterior accents. - Leather-Trimmed Seats with Red Stitching Create a more premium, sport-inspired cabin with distinctive contrast detailing. - Red Ambient LED Interior Lighting Adds a warm, dramatic accent to the cabin after dark. - Gloss-Black Exterior Accents Include distinctive mirror treatments and exterior details that enhance the Sport-L's athletic character. - Heated Front Seats Provide welcome comfort during colder mornings and winter driving. - Power-Adjustable Front Seats Allow personalized seating adjustments to improve comfort during longer journeys. - One-Touch Power Moonroof Brings natural light and fresh air into the cabin. - Dual Power Sliding Doors Make entering and exiting easier, particularly in tight parking spaces. - Power Tailgate Adds convenience when loading groceries, luggage, and other belongings. - Magic Slide Second-Row Seats Provide exceptional flexibility for changing passenger arrangements and easier third-row access. - Magic Seat Third Row Folds conveniently into the rear floor to create an expanded cargo compartment. - Tri-Zone Automatic Climate Control Allows separate temperature settings for the driver, front passenger, and rear passengers. - Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Provide convenient smartphone integration without requiring a cable. MECHANICAL FEATURES Under the hood, the 2025 Odyssey Sport-L features Honda's refined 3.5-liter i-VTEC V6 engine, producing an impressive 280 horsepower and 262 lb-ft of torque. This naturally aspirated powerplant provides the kind of smooth, confident performance that makes a substantial family vehicle feel comfortable and responsive in everyday driving. Unlike smaller turbocharged engines found in some competing vehicles, Honda's V6 delivers progressive power throughout its operating range. Its substantial horsepower makes merging onto busy highways, passing slower vehicles, and traveling with a full complement of passengers feel confident and relaxed. The sophisticated 10-speed automatic transmission is another important advantage. Its closely spaced ratios help provide responsive acceleration, while the higher gears contribute to quiet, relaxed highway cruising. Honda's Variable Cylinder Management system can deactivate selected cylinders under suitable light-load conditions, helping conserve fuel while retaining full V6 performance when needed. The Odyssey's front-wheel-drive platform is complemented by a carefully tuned independent suspension and a relatively low center of gravity. This gives it composed handling and a comfortable highway ride that feels remarkably car-like for such a spacious vehicle. Mechanical highlights include: - 3.5-Liter i-VTEC V6 Engine Produces 280 horsepower and 262 lb-ft of torque. - 10-Speed Automatic Transmission Delivers smooth, responsive shifting and relaxed highway cruising. - Variable Cylinder Management Can deactivate selected cylinders under suitable driving conditions to help improve fuel efficiency. - Front-Wheel Drive Provides predictable everyday handling and efficient power delivery. - Intelligent Traction Management with Snow Mode Adjusts selected vehicle responses to help improve traction during appropriate slippery conditions. - MacPherson Strut Front Suspension Helps balance responsive steering and comfortable ride quality. - Multi-Link Rear Suspension Contributes to stable handling and passenger comfort. - Electric Power-Assisted Steering Makes low-speed maneuvering easy while providing reassuring highway stability. - Four-Wheel Anti-Lock Disc Brakes Support controlled stopping performance. - Active Noise Cancellation Helps reduce certain unwanted engine and road noises inside the cabin. EPA-estimated fuel economy of 19 mpg city, 28 mpg highway, and 22 mpg combined provides an appealing balance of strong V6 performance and everyday efficiency for an eight-passenger family vehicle. EXTERIOR FEATURES Finished in beautiful Radiant Red Metallic II, this Odyssey Sport-L has an especially appealing appearance. The rich red metallic paint beautifully complements its exclusive gloss-black wheels, dark exterior detailing, and sophisticated refreshed bodywork. The redesigned 2025 front fascia introduces a more contemporary and athletic appearance, while the Sport-L's gloss-black mirror housings, 19-inch Berlina Black alloy wheels, and distinctive rear styling give it a personality that feels far removed from the traditional image of a minivan. LED headlights, LED daytime running lights, and LED fog lamps provide a modern lighting signature and useful nighttime illumination. The power sliding rear doors are among the Odyssey's most practical exterior features. Unlike traditional hinged doors, they allow passengers to enter and exit more easily in narrow parking spaces, making daily family transportation considerably more convenient. The power tailgate provides easy access to the generously sized cargo area, while the low rear load floor makes handling luggage, groceries, strollers, and other larger items particularly manageable. A power moonroof further enhances the experience, adding fresh air and natural light to the interior. The result is a wonderfully balanced vehicle that combines family-oriented practicality with an attractive, sporty exterior presentation. INTERIOR FEATURES Inside, this Odyssey Sport-L offers one of the most intelligently designed and versatile interiors in the family-vehicle market. Its Black leather-trimmed seats with distinctive Red stitching create a sophisticated atmosphere, while the Sport-L's Red ambient lighting adds a subtle, performance-inspired touch. The front seats provide excellent comfort, with power adjustments, heating, and supportive contours designed to make both short commutes and extended journeys more enjoyable. The driver's memory function adds convenience when the vehicle is shared between multiple drivers. The second row is where the Odyssey truly distinguishes itself. Honda's innovative Magic Slide seating system allows the individual seats to move laterally when the center seat is removed, making it easier to accommodate different passenger arrangements and access the third row. The third-row Magic Seat is another particularly clever feature. Rather than requiring the entire rear bench to be removed, it folds into the cargo floor, transforming the Odyssey into a remarkably spacious cargo carrier. Cargo capacity is exceptional, offering approximately 32.8 cubic feet behind the third row and up to 155.8 cubic feet of maximum cargo volume with the appropriate seating configuration. Additional interior highlights include: Leather-trimmed seats with Red stitching. Heated front seats. Power-adjustable front seats. Driver's seat memory. Tri-zone automatic climate control. Power moonroof. Magic Slide second-row seating. Fold-into-floor third-row Magic Seat. Eight-passenger seating capability. Integrated second- and third-row sunshades. Red ambient LED lighting. Leather-wrapped steering wheel with Red stitching. Wireless smartphone charging. Multiple USB-C charging ports. Generous center-console and cabin storage. INFOTAINMENT & TECHNOLOGY The refreshed 2025 Odyssey brings a significantly more modern technology experience, highlighted by Honda's updated nine-inch touchscreen infotainment system and seven-inch digital driver information display. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are particularly useful, allowing compatible smartphones to connect without requiring a physical cable. Drivers can access supported navigation applications, music, messaging, and communication features through the central touchscreen. The wireless smartphone charger adds another welcome convenience, while the available USB connections throughout the cabin help keep passengers' devices charged during longer journeys. Honda's CabinTalk feature is especially thoughtful for families, allowing the driver's voice to be communicated more clearly to rear passengers through the audio system. Technology highlights include: - 9-Inch Color Touchscreen Provides a modern central interface for entertainment, smartphone connectivity, and vehicle settings. - Wireless Apple CarPlay Supports compatible iPhone applications without requiring a wired connection. - Wireless Android Auto Allows compatible Android smartphones to connect wirelessly. - 7-Inch Digital Driver Information Display Presents useful driving, trip, and vehicle-status information. - Wireless Smartphone Charger Provides convenient charging for compatible devices. - Bluetooth Hands-Free Connectivity Supports wireless calling and audio streaming. - Seven-Speaker Audio System Provides clear, balanced sound throughout the spacious cabin. - CabinTalk In-Car PA System Helps the driver communicate with passengers seated farther back in the vehicle. - Smart Entry with Walk Away Auto Lock Makes everyday vehicle access and securing the vehicle more convenient. - Remote Engine Start Adds comfort during changing weather conditions. - HondaLink Capability Supports eligible vehicle-connected information and services. Subscription may be required to maintain service. SAFETY FEATURES The 2025 Odyssey Sport-L benefits from Honda Sensing, an extensive collection of advanced driver-assistance technologies designed to help improve awareness, reduce driving fatigue, and provide additional assistance during certain potentially hazardous situations. Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow is particularly useful during highway travel and stop-and-go traffic, while the Collision Mitigation Braking System and Lane Keeping Assist provide valuable additional support. The Blind Spot Information System and Cross Traffic Monitor enhance awareness during lane changes and reversing maneuvers, while the Odyssey's carefully engineered body structure and comprehensive airbag protection provide an important foundation for family transportation. description:
If you know our dealership, you know we love getting clean local vehicles from customers we can put a story behind, and this 2023 Chrysler Pacifica Limited is exactly that. It is a one owner, clean Carfax, local trade in with only 47,466 miles. The previous owners simply decided it was time to downsize into something smaller, and now somebody else gets a seriously loaded family vehicle. It is CERTIFIED UP TO 7 YEARS 100,000 MILES.

Finished in Brilliant Black Crystal Pearl with a Black and Alloy leather interior, this Pacifica Limited has a much more upscale feel than the average minivan. Power comes from Chryslers proven 3.6L V6 paired with a 9 speed automatic transmission.

Inside, you get heated and ventilated front seats, heated second row seats, heated steering wheel, driver memory, power front seats, wireless phone charging, tri zone climate control, hands free power sliding doors, hands free power liftgate, and the huge Dual Pane Panoramic Sunroof.

This one also has the Uconnect Theater Family Group, and this is where it really becomes a road trip machine. You get rear seat entertainment screens, Amazon Fire TV Built In, Blu Ray DVD capability, video remotes, media and USB connections, FamCAM interior camera, Stow n Vac integrated vacuum, and the upgraded Harman Kardon premium audio system with 19 speakers and a subwoofer.

Technology up front includes Uconnect 5 Navigation with a 10.1 inch touchscreen, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, SiriusXM, WiFi hotspot capability, wireless charging, and plenty of USB connections throughout the cabin.

Safety equipment includes Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Blind Spot Monitoring, Rear Cross Path Detection, Full Speed Forward Collision Warning Plus, Pedestrian Emergency Braking, Lane Departure Warning Plus, ParkSense parking assistance, and a rear backup camera.

One owner. Clean Carfax. Local trade. Certified coverage. Limited. Heated and cooled leather. Heated second row. Panoramic roof. Harman Kardon audio. Rear entertainment. Fire TV Built In. FamCAM. Stow n Vac. Power sliding doors. This Pacifica is loaded with the kind of equipment that makes family life and long trips a whole lot easier.

We are a hometown family owned and operated dealership, and we would rather earn your business for years than just sell you a vehicle today. Bring the family, take your time looking it over, check out the rear entertainment system and all three rows, and take it down the road. If you need the space of a minivan but do not want to give up comfort, technology, and luxury, this Pacifica Limited is absolutely worth the trip.

Meet the 2025 Chrysler Pacifica Select, a used seven-passenger van finished in Gray with a Black interior and 60,053 miles. Pandora internet radio, engine start and cabin preconditioning through a smart device app, a touchscreen radio display, connected Amazon Alexa apps, and electronic messaging assistance with read function add convenient ways to stay connected.

2025 Chrysler Pacifica Performance Features

Auto start/stop helps manage engine operation, and the touring-tuned suspension is designed for a composed ride.
